scheme_name: Pension Benefit for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Must have worked as a building worker for at least one year
Must be a resident of Delhi
Must be a registered worker of the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹3000 per month after reaching 60 years, with an additional ₹300 for each additional year of membership beyond five years.
